page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8475B processors running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for multi-tier applications. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource ratio offer a stable performance profile for enterprise workloads without the premium cost associated with specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware.

The balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio makes the ecs.g8i.16xlarge suitable for a variety of general-purpose workloads. These include medium-to-large web application servers, enterprise application hosting, containerized microservices, build systems, and database nodes that do not require high-performance local storage.
